edges.reason: Acacia tree is placed to the right of spawn; finding it reveals the orange path turning left toward the loom area, which is hidden behind a stone wall from spawn
The loom workshop area contains a torch trail leading further back and right to the lodestone alcove, which is not visible from spawn or the acacia tree

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The acacia tree trunk is at spawn-relative (8, 2, 6) — the midpoint of the 5-block trunk. The player must navigate right along the orange path and approach the tree. max_distance=5 requires the player to walk within 5 blocks of the trunk (direct distance from spawn is ~10 blocks, so this cannot be satisfied from spawn). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the tree, confirming visual discovery.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The loom is at spawn-relative (-5, 0, 12). The player must follow the yellow path from the acacia tree area leftward to the loom workshop. max_distance=5 requires the player to walk within 5 blocks of the loom (direct distance from spawn is ~13 blocks, so this cannot be satisfied from spawn or from the acacia tree area which is ~15 blocks away). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the loom block.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The lodestone is at spawn-relative (5, 0, 19). The player must follow the red path from the loom area rightward to the lodestone shrine. max_distance=5 requires the player to walk within 5 blocks of the lodestone (direct distance from spawn is ~20 blocks, and from the loom at (-5,0,12) it is ~12 blocks, so this cannot be satisfied from any previous waypoint). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the lodestone.

scene_description: A non-linear exploration scene with three landmarks arranged in a zigzag pattern. An acacia tree is to the right-forward (8,0,6), a loom workshop is to the left-far (−5,0,12), and a lodestone shrine is to the right-far (5,0,19). Stone brick occlusion walls prevent seeing the next landmark until the current one is reached. Colored concrete paths (orange→yellow→red) guide the player between waypoints.
task_text: Follow the colored paths to find three landmarks: first locate the acacia tree by following the orange path, then find the loom by following the yellow path, and finally discover the lodestone by following the red path.
design_notes: Zigzag layout: spawn(0,0,0) → orange path leads RIGHT to acacia(8,0,6) → yellow path leads LEFT to loom(-5,0,12) → red path leads RIGHT to lodestone(5,0,19). Stone brick walls at (4-6,0-3,4), (3,0-3,8-11), and (-2 to 0,0-3,16) provide occlusion between landmarks. Each landmark is only discoverable after reaching the previous waypoint and following the next colored path. Total walking distance ~45 blocks through the zigzag.
